ordinary_meaning: Principal non-reflex angle between two nonzero rays, measured in radians. Genuine Euclidean rectilinear angle configurations additionally exclude collinearity.

chosen_form.angle_cosine: have fn, nonzero arms inside signature
chosen_form.ray_angle: have fn as principal arccos of normalized dot; strict Session checked

minimal_interface: have fn ray_angle(p, q, r cart(R, R): p != q, r != q) R = arccos(angle_cosine(p, q, r))
domains: nonzero arms; derived cosine bounds [-1,1]; result [0,pi]; radians
nearest_rejected_form: Uninterpreted angle-addition predicate or declaring I.13 collinearity alone; neither expresses the source magnitude sum.
dependencies: normalized dot bound from Lagrange identity
immediate_use_probe: P=(0,1), Q=(0,0), A=(1,0), B=(-1,0): each ray angle pi/2, sum pi; P=Q must reject at function domain.

status.angle_cosine_bounded: strict Session checked using Lagrange identity and independently verified scalar ratio bound
status.relation_measure_bridge: forward checked: existing relation implies equal normalized cosine and equal principal measure; reverse remains pending
status.supplementary_bridge: strict Session checked: opposite normalized cosines imply sum pi
status.right_angle_measure: strict Session checked: existing right-angle relation implies measure pi/2
status.right_angle_measure_converse: strict Session checked: measure pi/2 implies original right-angle relation
status.zero_arm_control: rejected at (0,0)!=(0,0), ordinary failure followed by positive use
